title: Quadratic form for opposite signs
statement:
Let $-1<\rho<1$, $a\in\mathbb R$, and $\sigma\in\{-1,1\}$. For $R=\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\\rho&1\end{pmatrix}$ and $y=(\sigma a,-\sigma a)^{\mathsf T}$, the quadratic form satisfies
\[
y^{\mathsf T}R^{-1}y=\frac{2a^2}{1-\rho}.
\]
